# BachatAtBazaar.pk

> Pakistan's smart shopping marketplace — premium Himalayan superfoods, wellness products and everyday essentials with nationwide delivery.

BachatAtBazaar.pk brings carefully selected quality products from across Pakistan and beyond, starting with premium Himalayan superfoods (buckwheat, sea buckthorn) and growing into a full everyday marketplace. Nationwide delivery, cash on delivery and popular digital wallets supported.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Featured products, categories and current deals.
- [Shop](/shop): Full product catalogue with filters and sorting.
- [About](/about): Our story and mission.
- [Contact](/contact): Reach the team by email, phone or WhatsApp.
- [FAQs](/faqs): Ordering, payments, shipping and returns.
- [Track order](/track-order): Look up an order by number and email.

## Categories

- [Himalayan Buckwheat](/category/himalayan-buckwheat): Stone-milled buckwheat flour, groats and tea from Gilgit-Baltistan.
- [Sea Buckthorn](/category/sea-buckthorn): Wild-harvested sea buckthorn juices, oils and superfood products.
- [Wellness & Superfoods](/category/wellness-superfoods): Everyday wellness essentials sourced with care.
